combo_label: In the Bathroom × Maps & Navigation × Vikings

entries.clue: Broad two-handed blade, or, jokingly, a formidable old matron
A sailor's map, inked with depths, wrecks and shoals
Big book of the world that lived in the car's door pocket
Looping line linking every point at one height
The smallest room's centrepiece, plumbed and porcelain
Raider whose countrymen held England's north and east under their own law
Hot white cloud that fogs the mirror and beads the tiles
Slippery bar that leaps from wet hands like a fish
Viking-age memorial slab, its message spelled in angular staves
Chrome spout you twist for hot or cold
Palm-sized dial whose arrow never forgets where north is
